mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from prior month, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 104.0 signals manufacturing sector recovery that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises by at least 0.3% from prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures that prompt restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior three months indicates robust consumer spending that supports earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over prior three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by at least 0.1% from prior month, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
